Between the 2022 and 2023 seasons, **EPCOT** experienced the largest absolute increase in attendance.

| Park | 2022 Attendance | 2023 Attendance | Growth (absolute) |
|------|-----------------|-----------------|-------------------|
| Magic Kingdom | 17,133 000 | 17,720 000 | +587 000 |
| EPCOT | **10,000 000** | **11,980 000** | +1,980 000 |
| Disney’s Hollywood Studios | 10,900 000 | 10,300 000 | –600 000 |
| Disney’s Animal Kingdom | 9,027 000 | 8,770 000 | –257 000 |

The figure shows EPCOT’s attendance rising by **1.98 million visitors**, which is the largest increase of any Walt Disney World park between those two years. 

Source: *Walt Disney World Statistics* table (MagicGuides) – “2022 Attendance” and “2023 Attendance” for each park.

steps.text:
Between the 2022 and 2023 seasons, **EPCOT** experienced the largest absolute increase in attendance.

| Park | 2022 Attendance | 2023 Attendance | Growth (absolute) |
|------|-----------------|-----------------|-------------------|
| Magic Kingdom | 17,133 000 | 17,720 000 | +587 000 |
| EPCOT | **10,000 000** | **11,980 000** | +1,980 000 |
| Disney’s Hollywood Studios | 10,900 000 | 10,300 000 | –600 000 |
| Disney’s Animal Kingdom | 9,027 000 | 8,770 000 | –257 000 |

The figure shows EPCOT’s attendance rising by **1.98 million visitors**, which is the largest increase of any Walt Disney World park between those two years. 

Source: *Walt Disney World Statistics* table (MagicGuides) – “2022 Attendance” and “2023 Attendance” for each park.
